cards.answer: Amumu is a tank and support who pulls himself into enemies and stuns nearby foes. He deals magic damage and makes cursed enemies take extra true damage from incoming magic damage. Focus on learning his tank role with health, armor and magic resistance.
cards.counterplay: Dodge his bandage and spread out when he approaches to limit his area stun.

cards.counterplay: Avoid taking magic damage while cursed when possible.

cards.answer: Amumu throws a bandage in a direction, dealing magic damage to and stunning the first enemy hit while pulling himself to them. He stores up to two charges that replenish over time.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the bandage's path. Be ready for another cast because he can store two charges.

cards.priority_reason: The stun and dash let Amumu start fights, and stored charges allow a follow-up.
uncertainties: Spell shields do not prevent the dash, and immobilization does not prevent it from commencing.
Dash tracking has a distance exception; the projectile can still damage and stun after Amumu dies.

cards.answer: Amumu toggles an aura that continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies, including damage based on their maximum health. Its damage refreshes existing Curse marks.
cards.counterplay: Move away from Amumu to leave the damaging aura and stop it refreshing your existing Curse.

cards.answer: Tantrum passively reduces incoming physical damage. Activating it deals magic damage to nearby enemies. Basic attacks that hit Amumu reduce its remaining cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance to avoid the area damage. Account for your basic attacks helping him use Tantrum again sooner.

cards.priority_reason: Physical damage reduction and attack-driven reuse matter in extended close-range fights.

cards.answer: Amumu deals magic damage to surrounding enemies, briefly interrupts their dashes and stuns them. He also applies Curse to affected enemies.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and keep away from Amumu when he approaches to avoid several teammates being stunned together.
